If a batch satisfies recovered x 10,000 <= (input - pending) x ceiling before an assay, and the assay is accepted, it still does afterwards. Together with the base case (a fresh batch has nothing recovered), this covers every sequence of assays, not just two.

check_gradeIsMonotone(uint16,uint16,uint.notice: Raising the lower bound (more confidence the pack is healthy) never produces a worse grade, for a fixed interval width.

check_gradeIsSound(uint16,uint16).notice: The grading rule never sends a pack to reuse or second life on an interval it does not support.

check_twoPassesNeverBeatTheCeiling_9900(.notice: Two passes in a row (the second works on the first one's residual): the total recovered can never beat the ceiling on the total processed. This is the "park metal as unprocessed, then claim it at 100%" attack. Proven for both ceilings the contract uses (9,800 bps lithium, 9,900 bps the rest).

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).
